items.title: 3 US Broker Stocks Where Higher Rates Could Lift Interest Income
items.summary: Interest rates are rising again, inflation is still sticky, and suddenly the sleepy corner of brokerage cash and margin lending looks anything but boring. When the Fed pushes the benchmark rate to a range of 3.75% to 4%, every idle dollar in a brokerage account and every margin loan starts to matter more to investors and to the brokers themselves. This article walks through three US retail broker-dealer stocks that screen as exposed to these crosscurrents, and explains how higher-for-longer...

items.summary: A number of stocks fell in the afternoon session after investors kept bidding the group lower after last week’s Federal Reserve hike.
